header: A row of tabs shared by the cards of the search bar (the AICPI card's tabs, the Durgapur areas card's tabs): a real tab list (the arrow keys, Home and End move between the tabs), and the chosen tab has a pill that slides to it. I write `gradient`, the pill's colour, as whole Tailwind classes so that the stylesheet has them.
